summary: Hepsi walked Ryan and Leland through the meeting notes manager module she wants prototyped: an agent that extracts action items from a transcript, stores them, and drafts follow-up emails in the organizer's voice. She explained this is a standalone mockup (not a PRD) to hand off to engineering, noted that Outlook integration isn't confirmed yet, and that transcript import on her own build is currently broken because of a half-configured Anthropic API key. The team also worked through GitHub access requests needed to collaborate on the repo.

action_items.description: Submit a GitHub access request ticket to enable pushing code to a shared repository
Send Leland a sample transcript file to test importing/downloading
Create a shared GitHub folder/repo for the extraction agent work and push initial code
Enable Outlook integration so action-item emails can actually be sent
Schedule a follow-up sync to continue design discussion
